cost_model: advanced $5/1k requests (10 results included) + Extract $1/1k URLs x3 = $0.008. Response has a usage[] SKU list but no dollar figure.

docs.supports: objective <=5000 chars, 1-5 keyword queries of 3-6 words, pitfalls
turbo/fast/basic/advanced latency, price, advanced for deep research
exact V1SearchRequest schema, advanced_settings, source_policy.after_date, fetch_policy

post_steps.why: Search/Extract best practices: reuse one session_id across Search and Extract for a task; full_content when the whole page is needed.

query_transform_notes: Required by the API shape and the docs: 'Don't send the raw question as both objective and the only search query.' The shared query-writer (frozen prompt, frozen model, run once per question, outputs stored) writes a goal-style objective that embeds the question verbatim, plus 2-3 keyword queries of 3-6 words, <=200 chars, no sentences, no site:, key entity in every query.

rationale.client_model: Lets Search size excerpts for the consuming model (documented field).
rationale.fetch_policy: Omitted: live fetching 'noticeably increases latency' and restrictive settings reduce coverage.
rationale.mode: 'advanced' (API default) is documented for 'multi-hop background agents that can tolerate extra latency', deep research. sew/providers.py defaults to 'fast'; this profile must pin 'advanced'.

advanced_settings.excerpt_settings.note: No documented default for excerpt size; docs say max_chars_total default is dynamic by objective/queries/client_model. Left unset so the vendor sizes excerpts for the client model.

client_model.note: Docs give examples (claude-opus-4-7, gpt-5.4, gemini-3.1-pro); whether newer ids are recognised is not stated.
